why: Counts a chip's place among the SHOWN chips instead of among all of the bar's children. `:nth-child` counts hidden children too, and the bar always has some (Practice outside Level Select, Level and the stock readout outside their modes), so this names a plausible chip that is the wrong one: the most likely way to get the selector wrong, and one no unique-count check alone would see.
